sources.snippet: EfficientViT is a new family of ViT models for efficient high-resolution dense prediction vision tasks. The core building block of EfficientViT is a lightweight, multi-scale linear attention module that achieves global receptive field and multi-scale learning with only hardware-efficient operations, making EfficientViT TensorRT-friendly and suitable for GPU deployment.
